scientific_question: Which high-speed flow region is strongest in the carotid artery flow field, and where is it located? For this analysis, compute speed as the Euclidean magnitude of the stored point-data vector array named `vectors`, then define high-speed locations as those at or above the 90th percentile of its non-zero values, treat locations connected through shared grid faces as one contiguous region, use peak speed as the measure of strength, and represent the strongest region by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations. Identify the strongest region and report its location and strength.

case_context.physical_setting: Blood flow in human carotid arteries
